C1012.title: Gold Farming Studio Convicted for Copyright Infringement; CrossFire Assists Police in Full-Chain Anti-Cheat Crackdown
C1012.summary: A Jiaozhou court in Shandong heard a CrossFire cheat case: Li B made cheats and earned more than 150,000 yuan, while Li A rented accounts using the cheat for more than 30,000 yuan and used automated map farming to obtain CF Points and other resources for about 20,000 yuan in profit. Police arrested the two in January and February 2023, and the court found both guilty of copyright infringement in February 2024, imposing prison terms and fines and extending enforcement to cheat use.
